Six different silhouettes of ONE small irregular falling ash flake, broad torn soot-bone shapes, not sparks or snow. Each frame occupies the middle HALF of its cell with at least 20 percent empty magenta margin on all four sides. Fixed origin, scale and camera; reading order. No separators, drawn boxes, labels, faces, skulls, objects or letters. Flat pigment values, no cast shadow. All six cells contain visible different effect shapes.
